status: Recovered resource chunk control flow, not complete resource/object parsing or gameplay.

functions.label: resource_type_hash
functions.recoveryNotes: Seed 0x1505, ASCII-only lowercase, wrapping multiply by 33; byte values above 127 remain unsigned.

functions.label: resource_dispatch
functions.recoveryNotes: First matching registry entry wins. Unknown read chunks seek from the length-word position by length; unknown write chunks produce no output. Known writes patch length including its own word and restore the end position.

functions.label: resource_next_chunk
functions.recoveryNotes: Zero initializes the type before reading; dispatches nonzero types and returns the original type.

functions.label: resource_close
functions.recoveryNotes: Write mode with nonzero slowFlag flushes one byte at +0xb4 without progress accounting; closes the handle and decrements the separate open counter even on close failure.

functions.label: resource_close_wrapper
functions.recoveryNotes: Original wrapper calls the recovered close routine.

functions.label: resource_read_file
functions.recoveryNotes: Original resource header, repeated chunk reads until zero, then original close. Existing-open stream only; native opening/startup remains unfinished.

relocatedGlobals.meaning: Chunk registry descriptor; table/count are installed by the browser owner, not original registry allocation.
Open-serialization count; original open/startup increment path remains unported.

limits: Complete four-byte chunk length reads; the original length local is otherwise uninitialized.
A bounded, valid registry of stable hash/token pairs; registration/growth and the original allocator are not recovered.
Only the five exact no-argument Thumb callback tokens in nativeCallbackTokens are accepted, each mapped to an actual recovered native body.
Resource-file looping requires a bounded terminating stream; the browser asset walker validates structural bounds before invoking it.
The core, serializer and resource component share one linear memory and one temporary arena; this is not a complete original game heap or general relocation solution.

Read/write/tell/seek/close use the documented controlled memory-file host model; complete original SDK behavior, open/seek ownership, asset factories, graphics, audio, saves and gameplay remain unfinished.
hostScope: Unmodified original ARM/Thumb game bodies execute with controlled external SDK memory-file/progress services. Native callback tests run actual original callback bodies, not substituted game callbacks. Registry installation and existing-open stream binding are development/browser integration.
